authority: Manager clarified execution before final; sealed cases and oracles remain unchanged
clarification: A separate original-menu diagnostic selection runs only when the original full controller makes zero actual model calls. A native no-tool TextSession response is actual model inference, with no model tool-selection opportunity and no redundant diagnostic probe.
measurement: Original controller tool-selection opportunities and diagnostic probes have distinct denominators. No-tool controller outcomes measure deterministic routing plus actual response; they are not described as the model choosing abstention when no tool menu was offered.
failures: Inference admission failures remain end-to-end failures. Conditional selection metrics do not remove them from unconditional case outcomes.
